subject: Sandbox grant gating & procurement path for Helios pilot
messages:
From: Sasha Kim <sasha@helioslabs.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helioslabs.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot sandbox grant & procurement questions

Hi Vivek —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Helios is excited about trying Redwood for our NLU tooling. Before we spin up anything we need to confirm two things so we can loop in Legal/Procurement: 1) What exact credits would you provide for a 30-day sandbox pilot (expected usage ~50k tokens/day average, occasional spikes); 2) Are there standard SOW or MA (mutual action) templates you prefer for accelerator-style credits?

I attached a short summary of our expected usage and a procurement contact. Can you help gate us for a pilot credit and outline the path to get sign-off (DocuSign/PO/etc)?

Thanks —
Sasha Kim
Head of Platform Partnerships
Helios Labs
---
Attachment: usage_estimates.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Kim <sasha@helioslabs.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot sandbox grant & procurement questions

Hi Sasha —

Appreciate the clear usage note. Quick answers up front:
- Sandbox credit: we can approve a 45-day sandbox grant covering up to 2.5M tokens (net of embedding calls), with an overage threshold alert and a hard cap agreement if you prefer.
- Paperwork: we use a short MA + credit addendum for accelerator pilots; if Procurement needs a PO we can accept a PO referencing the MA.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll share a draft MA + credit addendum (attached) for your legal review.
2) You confirm procurement path (PO vs DocuSign).
3) We enable the sandbox and give a technical onboarding call with Solutions.

Two gating items for final approval from our side:
- SOC2 excerpts & security questionnaire (to confirm data handling)
- A brief mutual action plan (milestones: enable, test, evaluation checklist, wrap) — I drafted one attached.

If procurement is okay with a short addendum + PO, we can often close this within 72 hours. Looping in Priyom and Laura to help with the paperwork and to get you the MA draft.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: MA_plan_draft.pdf (PDF)
Attachment: sandbox_mutual_action_plan.docx (DOCX)
From: Sasha Kim <sasha@helioslabs.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helioslabs.ai
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot sandbox grant & procurement questions

Thanks Vivek — this is helpful. Procurement wants the following before they approve the PO:
1) SOC2 excerpt pages focused on data-in-transit and retention policies
2) A clear billing contact and invoice cadence (monthly is fine)
3) Confirmation we can terminate the sandbox at any time with no charge beyond the committed credits

Procurement will send a PO if we can get #1 and #3 in writing. I attached our procurement template; it’s short.

Two quick clarifications:
- We plan to run two integration sprints during the pilot (week 1 and week 3). Can Redwood guarantee a dedicated onboarding slot with Solutions?
- On overages: if usage spikes beyond the 2.5M cap, we’ll accept notifications and then a manual approval for any top-up.

Sasha
---
Attachment: helios_procurement_template.pdf
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Kim <sasha@helioslabs.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, procurement@helioslabs.ai
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot sandbox grant & procurement questions

Hi Sasha / procurement team —

All good — we can meet the three procurement asks. Specifics below and next actions: 

1) Security docs: attached SOC2_excerpts.zip with the pages on encryption and retention. That should satisfy procurement; happy to route a full report to your security contact under an NDA.
2) Billing: invoices monthly in arrears to billing@helioslabs.ai; net 30 is standard.
3) Termination: sandbox may be terminated by either party; unused credits expire at the sandbox end date and are not invoiced. We’ll add that language to the MA addendum.

Onboarding: we’ll schedule a 90-minute onboarding slot with Solutions for the week of Nov 29. Priyom — can you own that calendar invite and include a short runbook?

Conditional approval: Based on the submitted usage estimates and the procurement template, I’m approving the sandbox grant (45 days / 2.5M tokens). Final enablement will occur once we receive either: (A) a signed MA + addendum via DocuSign or (B) a PO referencing the MA and signed by an authorized Helios signer.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/templates/helios-pilot-agreement
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DEAL-2026-0911

Laura Bennett
Partnerships Ops (on behalf of Vivek)
Redwood Inference
